labels.found: What we found on your site
labels.noEvidence: No automated evidence captured for this obligation.

bfsg.name: Accessibility of the online shop
bfsg.requires: Consumer-facing online shops must be usable by people with disabilities, measured against EN 301 549, which adopts WCAG at level AA, and must publish an accessibility statement. The exemption is under 10 staff and under €2m turnover. Since January 2026 the market surveillance authority runs its own checks.

gpsr.name: Responsible person in the EU
gpsr.law: General Product Safety Regulation (EU) 2023/988, applicable since 13 December 2024
gpsr.requires: A product may only be placed on the EU market if an economic operator established in the EU is responsible for it, and that operator's name and contact details appear with the product offer.

lucid.name: Packaging registration
lucid.requires: Anyone first placing filled packaging on the German market must be registered in the LUCID register before the first shipment and must license those volumes with a dual system. Marketplaces must block sellers who are not.

manual-audit.title: Manual keyboard and screen-reader audit of the purchase path

gpsr-details.title: Name an EU responsible person and show the details with each product
gpsr-details.effort: Half a day, plus the appointment itself

lucid-register.title: Register in LUCID and license packaging with a dual system
lucid-register.effort: We broker this; typically 2–3 weeks end to end

label.title: Form fields without labels
label.text: Inputs and checkboxes with no label. A screen reader announces them as unlabelled.
label.effort: 5–15 min each, often one template fix for many

button-name.title: Buttons with no accessible name
button-name.text: Buttons announced only as "button", usually where an icon replaced the text.

link-name.title: Links with no accessible name
link-name.text: Links whose only content is an icon with no alternative text.

image-alt.title: Images without alternative text
image-alt.text: Images with no alt attribute, so the catalogue is unusable with a screen reader.

color-contrast.title: Text contrast below the required ratio
color-contrast.text: Text below the 4.5:1 contrast minimum, normally a few palette values repeated site-wide.
color-contrast.effort: Half a day for a palette pass

aria-required-parent.title: ARIA roles used outside their required structure
aria-required-parent.text: Roles used outside the parent structure they require, confusing assistive technology.

aria-required-children.title: ARIA containers missing required children
aria-required-children.text: Container roles missing the child roles they need, so the widget is announced wrongly.

aria-hidden-focus.title: Focusable elements hidden from assistive technology
aria-hidden-focus.text: Elements hidden from screen readers that are still reachable by keyboard.

nested-interactive.title: Interactive elements nested inside each other
nested-interactive.text: A control inside another control, so keyboard behaviour becomes unpredictable.

scrollable-region-focusable.title: Scrollable areas unreachable by keyboard
scrollable-region-focusable.text: Areas that scroll with a mouse but cannot be reached with the keyboard.

target-size.title: Touch targets below the minimum size
target-size.text: Controls below the 24×24 pixel minimum introduced in WCAG 2.2.
target-size.effort: Half a day for a component pass

link-in-text-block.title: Links distinguished only by colour
link-in-text-block.text: Links in body text distinguished from surrounding text only by colour.

aria-prohibited-attr.title: ARIA attributes used where they are not allowed
aria-prohibited-attr.text: ARIA attributes on elements that do not support them, so the value is ignored.

document-title.title: Page without a title
document-title.text: The page has no title element.

html-has-lang.title: Page language not declared
html-has-lang.text: No lang attribute, so German text may be read with English pronunciation.

region.title: Content outside landmarks
region.text: Content outside landmark regions, so users cannot skip between sections.

landmark-one-main.title: No main landmark
landmark-one-main.text: No main landmark, so there is nothing to skip to.

list.title: Malformed lists
list.text: List markup containing elements other than list items.

listitem.title: List items outside a list
listitem.text: List items with no parent list, so they are not announced as a list.

frame-title.title: Frames without titles
frame-title.text: Embedded frames with no title, announced only as "frame".

select-name.title: Select elements with no accessible name
select-name.text: Dropdowns announced with no indication of what they control.

duplicate-id-aria.title: Duplicate identifiers used by ARIA
duplicate-id-aria.text: Repeated ids referenced by ARIA, so the wrong element may be announced.
